description.summary: a configuration to control the security behavior

request.name: set_protector_color

description.summary: set the color of fill_color mode

request.description:
the RGBA values use pre-multiplied alpha.
The r, g, b and a arguments valid range is from UINT32_MIN (0) to UINT32_MAX (0xffffffff).
These arguments should be interpreted as a percentage, i.e. - UINT32_MIN = 0% of the given color component - UINT32_MAX = 100% of the given color component

request.name: set_protector_image

description.summary: set the image of fill_image mode

request.description: The default image is used if not set. The image format is force to DRM_FORMAT_ARGB8888.
